description: This file defines a class 'FileSelectListener' responsible for monitoring a specific file for changes and executing a callback function when new data is detected. It manages a separate thread to perform polling and file I/O operations.

classes.name: FileSelectListener
classes.description: A class encapsulating monitoring of a file for data changes, executing a callback upon detection, and handling thread management for polling operations.

methods.name: FileSelectListener
methods.description: Constructor initializing the listener with a file, buffer size, and callback function, and starting the polling thread.

methods.name: ~FileSelectListener
methods.description: Destructor stopping the polling thread safely.

methods.name: file_exists
methods.description: Checks whether the specified file exists by attempting to open and close it.

methods.name: pollLoop
methods.description: Main polling loop running in a separate thread that monitors the file for changes and reads new data when available, invoking the callback.
